name: Java
description: Code intelligence for Java projects with Eclipse JDT Language Server.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in Java files. The language server starts when a Java file opens in a project and stops when none are open. Java 21 or newer is required.
failed: The Java language server could not start.
missing: Install Java 21 or newer and set JAVA_HOME or add java to PATH.
